name: West ends of aisles 26-33 (customer shopping corridors, VERIFY-free): the auto PHARMACY seal disk (pt 277,617 r=130) reaches x<407, and its 12-pt bridge closes gaps up to ~14 pt, so the 13.8-14.0 pt aisle gaps between the west perimeter gondolas were plugged far from the aisle badges at x=434 (badge protection only covers +/-16 pt). South passage below the same gondola and west of the lower Cooking Connection island (poly starts x=934.1) — same 20-pt bridge plug (79-cell pocket at (918,356))

Stops at x=555 so the counter block's own staff notch (pockets at (591,503)/(601,508)) stays sealed

Aisle 24 east mouth (customer): the auto DELI disk (pt 526,376 r=130) just reaches this corner — dist((417,442),(526,376)) = 128 pt — and its 12-pt bridge closed the 12.6 pt gap between the aisle-23 gondola end (x=422.1, y=424-434) and the aisle-25 gondola end (x=425.4, y=448-458), sealing the mouth where the aisle-24 corridor (School Supplies / Toys / Greeting Cards) meets the west-wing action alley. The badge at (434,442) is 14 pt east of the plug, outside the +/-16 pt badge protection window's reach into the gap. The aisle stayed entrance-reachable from its west end, so no mechanical net fired, but the walk from the alley into aisle 24 was 186 pt instead of 106 pt (every other west-wing aisle measures 0.86-0.96x straight-line; aisle 24 measured 1.75x)

West-wing action-alley cross-overs at the aisle 25-29 badge lines (customer): a column of endcap display squares stands in the alley at x=444.6-454.8 with 12-15 pt gaps between them, and each gap lines up with an aisle badge — the east-west continuation of aisles 25/26, 26/27, 27/28, 28/29 and 29 across the alley. All five sit 55-100 pt from the FLORAL disk centre (565,525) and its 12-pt bridge plugged them (1.2-1.5 m² each at (449,466), (450,489), (450,513), (450,537), (450,561)). The squares themselves stay solid — an inclusion only restores cells the drawing already paints as floor

Market island passages west of the Sushiya/Meat Simple nook (customer): the same SEAFOOD disk (pt 1000,403 r=130 bridge=20) that over-plugged the nook east of x=928 also bridged the 15-18 pt gaps between the free-standing cases on the open Market floor west of it — the south corner of the Beer & Wine end gondola at (897,325), the Tortilleria diamond island to the case east of it at (887,369), and the two gaps in the Meat Simple case column at (905,429) and (905,470). No counter or wall is drawn anywhere in this block, so there was nothing here to seal
